subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve visible pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared `messages.ackText` config, a non-terminal send-and-continue hook, or channel-specific placeholder features only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but every plausible fix creates new config or plugin/channel API surface and changes visible message delivery across channels.

options.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus schema, docs, and delivery tests.

options.title: Add A Non-Terminal Hook
options.body: Expose a typed plugin/channel hook that can send interim text and then continue normal dispatch, leaving policy to channel owners or plugins.

options.title: Keep Placeholders Channel-Specific
options.body: Use narrower Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Feishu items for per-channel UX while leaving this issue as product-direction context.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus schema, docs, and delivery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and adjacent dispatch/channel-delivery history make this the strongest available routing owner for the API/product boundary choice.
